note: P4's stage-1 machinery is implemented and its inputs are frozen; no P4 model has been fitted. This file is the interlock. `nn.p4_stage1` refuses to fit anything while `state` is not exactly "authorised", and flipping it is a commit rather than a flag, so beginning a P4 fit is a reviewable diff with a name and a reason attached to it. The runner requires a second, independent confirmation at the command line as well, so a Make target or a script cannot start a fit on its own. `preregistration_hash` must equal `nn.p4_preregistration.preregistration_hash()` at the moment of the run: an authorisation granted under one design does not carry over to an edited one. Authorising stage 1 is not authorising stage 2 — P4-HOLD is a separate one-shot gate in `nn.p4_holdout`, and nothing here opens it.
